title: Contact Balce support
description: Tell us what you need. The Balce team will reply by email or phone.

form.messagePlaceholder: Describe the question or problem. What were you doing when it happened?
form.phoneInvalid: Use a Tanzanian mobile number like 0712 345 678
form.contactRequired: Give an email or a phone number so we can reach you
form.screenshotInvalid: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of 2 MB or less
form.includeDetails: Include technical details (app version, device, shop)
form.includedItems: App version, computer ID (desktop), operating system or browser, shop, language and the code of the last error you saw.
form.notSetUp: Support email isn't set up yet. Your message will be saved and sent later.

result.notSetUpText: It will be sent when support email is set up.
